fig_trace_workflow_v4.question: Which decision changes does TRACE distinguish?
fig_trace_workflow_v4.claim: Workload, released-label allocation, and review service answer separate evaluation questions for the same detector outputs.
fig_trace_workflow_v4.basis: The fixed TRACE comparator definitions and unchanged external rosters; this is a workflow diagram without simulated quantitative values.
fig_trace_workflow_v4.exclusions: Training counts, source-boundary audit logs and seals are reported in Methods/SI rather than occupying the main conceptual diagram.

fig_capacity_v4.question: How does finite analyst capacity change completion and policy ranking?
fig_capacity_v4.claim: Required review can exceed available capacity, while capped cost-versus-confidence rankings differ between collections.

panels.a: Boundary: fraction of fine-tuned CodeBERT project rosters completed by the original mandatory-review weighted policy across all predefined capacities.
panels.b: Decision comparison: full-roster paired source-cost-minus-confidence cost differences and precomputed project intervals at the same hard capacities.

fig_capacity_v4.unit: project after averaging three actual fine-tuned CodeBERT fits
fig_capacity_v4.exclusions: Main plot uses the primary neural detector and primary price scenario; both complete collections and all seven capacities retained. Reference detectors and every other fixed price scenario remain in SI/public aggregates.

fig_feedback_v4.question: Does delayed reviewed feedback change cost, and is enough history available to update?
fig_feedback_v4.claim: Primary rolling source calibration gives heterogeneous cost changes alongside limited arrived-label history.

panels.a: Decision comparison: every project paired rolling-minus-static source-calibrated cost at the primary slots/delay setting, with paired median intervals.
panels.b: Support for adaptation: all project counts of actually arrived reviewed labels at the same setting, with project medians.

fig_feedback_v4.unit: project after averaging actual fitted seeds
fig_feedback_v4.ordering: MegaVul recorded commit-author ordering; DiverseVul synthetic commit-hash ordering. Analyst service and feedback arrival are simulated in both.
fig_feedback_v4.exclusions: Primary fine-tuned CodeBERT,16 slots per whole-commit batch,3-batch delay,miss10/review0.1. Complete38/6 project rosters retained; all other fixed settings remain in SI/public aggregates.
